improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try 3 free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered AI assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
improvements.rationale: A well-crafted meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience. Including the price anchor (US$2/day) and free searches creates urgency and transparency, reducing bounce from mismatched expectations.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while clearly stating the risk-free trial offer. The phrase 'three free searches today' creates gentle urgency without pressure, and the copy remains factual without invented claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to join as a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose monthly flexibility or save 30 percent with an annual plan.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing the low entry price and benefits, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, encouraging conversion at the paywall moment.
